description: Privacy-first, GPU-accelerated speech-to-text desktop app that transcribes locally on your machine
notes: Echophrase was installed by Scoop, so its built-in updater is disabled.
Update it with: scoop update echophrase
Settings live in %APPDATA%\com.imperium42.echophrase and downloaded speech
models in ~\.cache\huggingface\hub. Both are outside the Scoop prefix, so they
survive uninstall. Delete them by hand if you want a completely clean removal.
pre_install: if ($dir -match ' ') { error 'The installation directory cannot include a space'; break }

script: # Start-Process is required because the NSIS installer misbehaves when its args are quoted (e.g. "`"/S`"").
# /D= must be the last argument, cannot be quoted, and cannot contain a space (guarded in pre_install).
# Move the installer up one level first: NSIS installs into $dir, and Scoop has already downloaded setup.exe there.

post_install: # Tells the app a package manager owns this install, so it disables its own
# updater and points the user at 'scoop update echophrase' instead.

script: # Run the app's own NSIS uninstaller so the registry entries it created -
# including the echophrase:// deep-link scheme used by sign-in - are removed.
# _?= is required: without it the NSIS uninstaller copies itself to %TEMP%, relaunches
# and exits at once, so -Wait returns early and Scoop deletes $dir mid-uninstall - leaving
# a stale HKCU Uninstall key that breaks the next GUI install ('Unable to uninstall!').
# _?= must be the last argument, unquoted, space-free (guarded in pre_install).
